description: AGRIBALYSE ships seven substances twice: once under a qualified compartment that lands correctly, and once under a bare or wrong one whose copy landed in the wrong dimension on the build of 1 September 2026 (run c5445e95) -- biogenic carbon dioxide, air and oxygen published as ground resources (the bare `Carbon dioxide, in air` row carries 235,299 kg of crop uptake in one Mexican agave dataset alone), standing wood as a ground resource, and the two fisheries as water rather than living resources. Seven items on the substance-in-two-places queue. Each wrong copy is re-filed in `agribalyse-3.2-manual-fixes.json` to the compartment its own qualified twin uses -- the treatment `Peat` and `Energy, from wood` already got -- and the fish are ruled biotic (project owner, 2026-09-01): a fishery is a living resource, and the vendor's own biotic copy already lands beside ecoinvent's. See #369 and agribalyse-land-and-sulfur-contexts.md §3.

expectations.title: AGRIBALYSE's bare biogenic carbon dioxide row reaches the Resource → Air flow its qualified twin uses
expectations.comment: The row that changes results: 23 uses, every one non-zero, crop carbon uptake published as a mineral resource on the build of 1 September 2026. The qualified `Resources / in air` twin already lands here.

expectations.title: The bare Air and Oxygen rows reach Resource → Air
expectations.comment: The Air row; Oxygen's (39b6549b-bf36-5ccf-84fe-b96ca3a96dce) follows identically and the one-place claims below cover both.

expectations.title: Both misfiled standing-wood rows reach Resource → Biotic
expectations.comment: The `Resources / in ground` copy of soft standing wood; the bare-heading copy of unspecified standing wood (c8e821e3-5907-5ca0-96d1-d6a4670233eb) is re-filed the same way.

expectations.title: The two misfiled fishery rows reach Resource → Biotic, where the vendor's own biotic copies already are
expectations.comment: Ruled by the project owner on 2026-09-01: a fishery is a living resource, and this is a vendor filing one row in two places, not a disagreement between vendors -- AGRIBALYSE's own `Resources / biotic` copy lands beside ecoinvent's. The pelagic row (77d55a91-e42c-50f1-8cac-3e2d9ad20c7d) follows identically. Trace amounts (1e-29 and 1e-19 kg), so this is tidiness where the carbon row is substance.

expectations.title: Biogenic carbon dioxide as a resource is published from air only
expectations.comment: One claim stands for the family: the seven wrong-dimension flows -- CO2 (biogenic), Air and Oxygen in Resource → Ground, both standing woods in Resource → Ground, both fisheries in Resource → Water → Unknown -- all trace to the same filing habit and vanish with the same eight re-files.
